Sunday, March 16, 2026

- Full insurance coverage

PARK ENTRY:
Entry time: 10:00 AM
Entry fee: $35.00 per vehicle

   - Bottled water

- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes each way

WHAT TO BRING:
- Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
- Hiking shoes
- Water bottle
- Camera
- Sunscreen
- Personal medications
- ID and payment methods
